# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Street Bakery

**Report ID:** RSB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 12, 2024
**Date of Report:** March 18, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Team
**Classification:** Internal — Quality & Safety

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:40 p.m. on March 12, the walk-in cooler and display-case refrigeration at Rosewood Street Bakery ceased operating due to a tripped breaker. Refrigeration was not restored until 5:15 a.m. the following morning, when the opening baker arrived and reset the breaker. Ambient temperature inside the walk-in cooler rose from 38°F to 61°F over the outage. As a precaution, the bakery discarded all temperature-sensitive inventory, closed for one day, and notified its health department contact voluntarily. No customer illness occurred, and no product left the premises during the affected window.

---
